ms.promise:
The outputs of Milestone 1 focus on the initial design of the UI and feedback on the design:
・Initial Designs

ms.criteria:
The final report shows clear evidence of the steps and outputs of the first Milestone.
To meet the acceptance criteria, the report must include:
・A motivational section followed by a section on user experience research.
・A section showcasing initial design images, accompanied by descriptions and justifications for design choices.
・A section summarizing the community feedback, including the corresponding evidence of the feedback in the form of links to posts on X and individual comments.
・A final section focusing on the next steps for UI design, based on the community feedback.

ms.promise:
The focus of Milestone 2 is on developing the User Interface (UI) based on the designs created in Milestone 1. This phase deals specifically with the development of the interface, as the entire project revolves around it.
Although Milestone 2 includes preliminary internal testing of the interface, the primary testing occurs in Milestone 3.
Therefore the outputs from Milestone 2 include:
・A functional user interface ensuring compatibility across various devices and browsers, based directly on the design concepts from the previous milestone.
・Preliminary integration of the UI with backend systems.
ms.criteria:
To get accepted, the milestone requires the following:
・A fully functional user interface that is compatible across major devices (mobile, tablet, desktop) and browsers.
・Successful preliminary integration with backend systems, demonstrated by seamless UI-backend interactions.
・The user interface should display a list of the available Machine Learning models, including an option to click on them to view addtional information, such as their description, community rating and usage cost.
・Users should be able to browse and search the different models.

ms.report:
Thanks a lot for the great feedback!
To explain: In addition to paying for model usage using ADA, the web3 integration is specific to the respective application in the playground. 
A good example is the AI-NFT generator: https://beta.unboundedmarket.ai/playground/appPage?appId=7571bb1f-54f2-4330-a5c3-ae9244027c97&modelId=
This application allows users to generate an image, pay for generation using ADA and then directly mint the generated image as a CNFT on Cardano blockchain.
